0022600138.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-3, 5th in the Central and 13th in the East) host the Houston Rockets (4-0, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West), who have won all four of their games so far. Houston is without Alperen Sengun (out, back soreness), Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Marcus Smart (day-to-day, a game-time decision, forearm strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-113 in Houston on April 1, 2026.
